notes: ours = tinygrad-self-training exp (DEV=NV, HCQ graph profile, PROFILE=1), vLLM 0.30 (nsys, cuda-graph-trace=node); ours traces 2026-09-26 via bench/spec/ours_prof.py / ours_pf_prof.py (host wall/step printed in each meta).
vLLM B=32 trace was produced 2026-09-26 with VLLM_CACHE_ROOT pointed at a fresh dir (the default cache holds a root-owned flashinfer autotune file that makes the engine fail at warmup).
ours relu2 is fused into ffn_down's input prep (counted in ffn_down); vLLM's relu2 kernel is mlp_act.
norm_residual includes the kernels before the first GEMM of a step (embedding, first norm); sampling_bookkeeping = everything after the output GEMM (sampler, vLLM input prep and mamba align copies).
ours decode steps carry the amortized state flush (state_flush) that runs every ~16 steps.

ours.command: cd /home/ubuntu/tinygrad-self-training && /home/ubuntu/scratchpad/bin/gpu-run time env PROFILE=1 HCQ_GRAPH_PROFILE_JSON=/home/ubuntu/storage/lifecycle/ours_b8_p200.jsonl DEV=NV PYTHONPATH=. python3 docs/nemotron-vllm-parity/bench/spec/ours_prof.py 8 200 1024 /home/ubuntu/storage/lifecycle/ours_b8_p200_meta.json

vllm.command: cd /home/ubuntu/vllm-bench && /home/ubuntu/scratchpad/bin/gpu-run time env PATH=/home/ubuntu/vllm-bench/.venv/bin:/usr/local/cuda/bin:$PATH CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER=0 GPU_UTIL=0.85 EXTRA='{"disable_log_stats": false}' nsys profile --capture-range=cudaProfilerApi --capture-range-end=repeat --cuda-graph-trace=node --trace=cuda,nvtx --sample=none --cpuctxsw=none -f true -o /home/ubuntu/storage/lifecycle/prof_b8_p200 .venv/bin/python prof.py 8:200 300 && nsys export --type sqlite -o /home/ubuntu/storage/lifecycle/prof_b8_p200.1.sqlite /home/ubuntu/storage/lifecycle/prof_b8_p200.1.nsys-rep
